editorial: Your pulse quickens as FBI Agent Lee Harker follows a trail that feels less like a crime line and more like a ritual floor. This psychological thriller stands apart by blending procedural grit with a dark occult mythology that creeps into every shadow. The film’s most potent element is the chilling score that turns quiet moments into a slow, oppressive hum, making the unknown feel almost tangible. You will be drawn into its unsettling world if you love tension that builds as you watch. The twist, however, might leave you feeling that the ending pushes the line between horror and justice a little too far.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
